name: Brand Identity Brief
description: Produces a brand identity brief with positioning statement, personality adjectives, visual tone, color rationale, typography direction, imagery style guide, and usage constraints. Use when the user asks to create a brand identity, define brand guidelines, establish visual brand direction, or build a brand brief for a new project. Do NOT use for color palette creation (use color-palette-design), typography system details (use typography-system), or logo design direction (use logo-design-brief).
